description: Use when the user pastes email headers and asks why a message failed SPF, DKIM or DMARC, went to spam or arrived late. Returns the Received hops with delays, the verdicts, domains and alignment. Offline; addresses masked. Ex: 'Why did this email fail DMARC?'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.

headers.description: The header section of one email as text (Received, Authentication-Results, From ...); the body may be left out.

name: email_headers
title: Email header analyzer
